latest_release.name: P(Doom) v0.13.1
latest_release.body:
Release v0.13.1 -- two soft-lock fixes over v0.13.0: the ledger event-orphan dialog (#883) and the staff-card ESC dead-mouse (#887). Both could strand a session; no other gameplay changes.

## Platform status (honest, 2026-07-26)
| Platform | File | Tested? |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | PDoom-Windows-v0.13.1.zip | Yes -- this is the supported lineage (v0.13.0 played extensively) |
| Linux | PDoom-Linux-v0.13.1.zip | NOT extensively tested -- it should boot; early feedback wanted |
| macOS | PDoom-macOS-v0.13.1.zip | NOT extensively tested -- it should boot; early feedback wanted |

If a build does not work on your machine, that is exactly the feedback we need: email team@pdoom1.com with your OS version and what happened. In-game, F8 saves a bug report file and shows you its path.

Windows SmartScreen: More info -> Run anyway. macOS Gatekeeper: right-click -> Open the first time. Linux: chmod +x the binary. Always EXTRACT the zip first -- running from inside the zip viewer breaks the game.
